gloss: relative volume — the bar’s volume divided by its 20-period average, as a multiple (1.0 = at baseline, 2.0 = twice baseline)

label: OBV (offset arbitrary)
gloss: on-balance volume — the running sum of sign(Δclose) × volume from the first bar this column reads, in base-asset units; its level is arbitrary, so read its change, slope or trend, which agree with any OBV chart’s

label: CMF (20)
gloss: 20-period Chaikin money flow — each bar's volume weighted by where it closed in its range (−1 at the low, +1 at the high, 0 on a flat bar), summed over the 20 bars ending at this bar and divided by their volume; no value when that volume is zero

period.description: The indicator’s length: the bars its window reads.

label: Order-flow CVD (UTC day)
gloss: order-flow cumulative volume delta — taker buy minus taker sell volume from the trade tape, accumulated since the daily 00:00-UTC anchor; it reads no value for the rest of the UTC day after a bar whose taker flow is unknown, never a partial sum

label: Cumulative Volume Delta (UTC day)
gloss: cumulative volume delta — each intrabar's volume signed by its close against its open, then against the previous intrabar's close, summed since the daily 00:00-UTC anchor; intrabars are 1m on minute and hour rungs and 5m on 1d

label: Order-flow spot CVD (composite, UTC day)
gloss: order-flow composite centralized-exchange spot cumulative volume delta at each bar, the listed venues that publish their trade history (Binance, Coinbase) summed through the bar's last minute since the daily 00:00-UTC anchor (crypto coins the spot lane lists), in the unit the coin's perp is quoted in (Hyperliquid's kPEPE is 1,000 PEPE); it reads no value for the rest of the UTC day after a minute any listed venue left uncovered, never a partial sum

label: Buy pressure
gloss: buy share of traded volume (0–1)

label: Buy pressure (Coinbase)
gloss: buy share of Coinbase's spot volume in the bar's period (0–1), from the venue's taker sides

label: Buy pressure (Binance)
gloss: buy share of Binance's spot volume in the bar's period (0–1), from the venue's taker sides

label: Spot avg trade
gloss: the composite spot volume per trade in the bar's period, over the listed venues that publish their trade history (Binance, Coinbase), in the unit the coin's perp is quoted in (Hyperliquid's kPEPE is 1,000 PEPE); absent where one of those venues did not cover the period or nothing traded

label: Spot dominance
gloss: the composite spot volume, over the listed venues that publish their trade history (Binance, Coinbase), as a share of composite spot plus the bar's perp volume (0–1), both in the unit the coin's perp is quoted in (Hyperliquid's kPEPE is 1,000 PEPE); absent where one of those venues did not cover the period

label: Buy trades
gloss: the bar's buy trade count

label: Sell trades
gloss: the bar's sell trade count

label: Funding rate
gloss: the perpetual funding rate (%), a point-in-time read at its own sample time

label: Funding annualized
gloss: the funding rate annualized (%), a point-in-time read at its own sample time

label: Funding label
gloss: the funding-pressure band over a point-in-time rate read at its own sample time

label: Open interest
gloss: open interest, USD notional — a point-in-time read at its own sample time

label: OI change
gloss: open interest against the mean of its own 24 hourly samples (%), each a point-in-time read at its own sample time

label: OI velocity
gloss: the pace of open-interest change across point-in-time samples, each read at its own sample time

label: OI · price regime
gloss: open interest's direction over its newest samples read against the 1h change, ((frame price − 1h bar open) / 1h bar open) × 100 — read live, so it moves until that bar closes

label: Regime · trend
gloss: the platform-classified trend regime

label: Regime · volatility
gloss: the platform-classified volatility regime

label: Regime · momentum
gloss: the platform-classified momentum regime

label: Regime · state
gloss: the market structure the platform classified — trend or range, up or down — at the confirmed close; its volatility and warnings are read beside it

label: Regime · conviction
gloss: how strongly the structure label holds: a trend’s tier moves with its volatility and its agreement with swing structure, a range’s with that agreement alone; never moved by a warning, and NOT how comfortably a gate cleared (the margins carry that)

label: Regime · run length
gloss: consecutive confirmed bars the structure label has held, unbounded — a warning or a volatility move inside it does not restart it; unresolved while the run’s start is unknown, across a bar the platform never classified or before the label next changes after a cold start

label: Regime · trend gate
gloss: whether this bar cleared the ADX trending gate (27), dropped below the exit gate (23), or landed in the buffer between them where the PREVIOUS bar’s trend is carried forward rather than re-confirmed

label: Regime · trend margin
gloss: ADX points by which the current trend label survives — distance above the exit gate (23) while trending, below the entry gate (27) while ranging; small inside the buffer zone

label: Regime · trend source
gloss: which evidence class voted the trend direction — a decisive DI spread, or the EMA(21)/EMA(55) alignment fallback that fires precisely when the DI spread is indecisive

label: Regime · DI spread
gloss: DI+ − DI− in points on the regime timeframe — the value of the DIplus14_DIminus14_spread column read at the regime rung, not at a lower anchor — gated against the directional threshold (5)
